official.deadline_note: Closing date was extended from 15 October 2026 at 11:00 to 10 November 2026 at 11:00 CET; the original AAP PDF still shows 15 October 2026.
official.status_note: The ANR call page shows the status 'Ouvert - 2026' with opening 24/06/2026 09:00 CEST and closing 10/11/2026 11:00 CET, and carries a published extension notice for the closing date.
official.funding_period: per project, minimum (axis bands in benefits)
benefits: Total budget envelope of 9 600 000 EUR for this 2026 call.

Aid requested must be a minimum of 500 000 EUR and maximum of 800 000 EUR for the pre-clinical axis, 800 000 EUR to 1 500 000 EUR for the clinical axis, and 800 000 EUR to 2 000 000 EUR for the mixed axis.
Beneficiaries of the aid are research organisations and higher education and research institutions; the PEPR itself is financed by France 2030 to the amount of 80 million euros over 7 years.
A webinar was held on 26 August 2026 and its presentation and FAQ are published on the call page.
eligibility: The coordinating institution must be a French higher education and research institution, a research organisation, or a foundation of scientific cooperation.
Project duration must be 24 to 48 months for the pre-clinical axis and 36 to 48 months for the clinical and mixed axes.
Clinical and mixed-axis projects are necessarily collaborative, with a minimum of two different French research structures.
Companies and foreign institutions may be associated as partners but cannot receive funding for that participation.
Projects mainly on addictions are not eligible, except where those conditions are addressed within precision psychiatry as secondary phenomena or comorbidities of one of the four targeted disorders.
requirements: Deposit the complete submission file on the ANR submission site before the closing date; only the electronic version present at the closing time is taken into account for evaluation.
The scientific document must imperatively follow the published template and be deposited in unprotected PDF format.
The administrative and financial document, signed by each partner institution and scanned, must be deposited as indicated in the call document.
Projects must integrate the sharing of data, results and knowledge in an open science logic.
For clinical studies, the data sets mobilised must be identified and documented from submission to guarantee feasibility within the granted duration.
documents: Scientific document (document scientifique): maximum 15 pages, written in English, following the published template, with in appendix the list of scientific publications of the last three years of the proposing researchers or teams.

Administrative and financial document (document administratif et financier) in Excel format, covering the administrative and budget description of the project, with the commitment letters of the partner institutions integrated.
Trame document scientifique, Trame de l'annexe publication and Trame du document administratif et financier, supplied by the ANR from the call page.
Data Management Plan (Plan de Gestion des Donnees, PGD): first version within the 6 months following project start.
selection_criteria: Excellence and scientific ambition in precision psychiatry: clarity of objectives and hypotheses, innovativeness, ambition, originality, methodological relevance, preliminary data and project feasibility.
Quality of the consortium, project management, resources mobilised and governance, including the project leader's capacity to coordinate ambitious multidisciplinary projects.
Impact and outcomes of the research, its capacity to address current and future precision-psychiatry issues.
coverage: A grant (dotation) to the coordinating institution, disbursed by the ANR according to the schedule set in the aid contract.

Eligible expenditure is set by the PEPR financial regulation; the call cites equipment purchases, personnel expenditure specifically assigned to the projects and associated running costs as examples of what the aid may finance.
Institutional research funding only: nothing is paid to individual students, and no tuition, living-cost or individual travel allowance is established.
application_method: Open an account (login and password) on the ANR submission site as early as possible.
Download the scientific document template, the publications annex template and the administrative and financial template from the call page.
Draft the scientific document in English, 15 pages maximum, and complete the administrative and financial Excel document with the aid amount inside the band for the chosen axis.
Obtain the signed commitment letters of all partner institutions and the legal representative signature on the administrative and financial document.
Upload the documents into the 'documents de depot' and 'documents signes' sections and validate the deposit electronically before 10/11/2026 at 11:00 CET.
official.application_route: The coordinating institution submits electronically through the ANR submission site at france2030.agencerecherche.fr before 10 November 2026, 11:00 CET.
official.citizenship_residency: No individual nationality or residency rule is published; the coordinating institution must be a French higher education and research institution, research organisation or foundation of scientific cooperation.
official.international_eligibility: Foreign institutions and companies may be associated as partners of a project but cannot receive funding for that participation.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Precision psychiatry targeting the four PEPR PROPSY disorders: bipolar disorders, resistant depressions, psychotic disorders and autism spectrum disorders. Addictions are out of scope except as secondary phenomena or comorbidities.
official.research_requirement: A research proposal on one of three axes - pre-clinical studies, clinical studies or clinical trials, or mixed projects - with the scientific document following the published template.
official.duration: 24 to 48 months for the pre-clinical axis; 36 to 48 months for the clinical and mixed axes.
official.description: Financed by France 2030, the PEPR PROPSY is a national programme piloted by Inserm and the CNRS in partnership with the Fondation FondaMental, aiming to transform the care of four disabling psychiatric disorders. This 2026 call funds precision-psychiatry research projects covering pre-clinical studies, clinical studies identifying or validating biomarkers, clinical trials and mixed projects.
official.english_requirement: The scientific document must be written in English, maximum 15 pages, on the published template.

not_confirmed: funding_amount as a single value - ANR publishes a total envelope of 9 600 000 EUR for the call plus per-project aid bands of 500 000 EUR to 2 000 000 EUR depending on the axis, so the recorded figure is the published minimum and the maximum is 2 000 000 EUR
tuition_coverage, living_cost_coverage and travel_coverage - the ANR publishes no statement on individual tuition, living costs or personal travel because the aid is institutional research funding
study_mode - no full-time or part-time rule is published on the call page
verification.notes: ANR call page read in full: the 9 600 000 EUR envelope, the three axis aid bands, the 24-48 and 36-48 month durations, the beneficiary categories and the extended 10 November 2026 closing date were all confirmed directly on the awarding body's page.

applicant_utility.summary: This is an institutional call, not a personal scholarship: a French coordinating organisation submits and receives the money, so an individual doctoral candidate cannot apply in their own name. Budget between EUR 500k and EUR 2M depending on the axis you pick, and note that the closing date has already been extended once from 15 October to 10 November 2026. If your project is clinical or mixed you must have a second French research structure committed before you can file, so consortium-building time is the real constraint, not the writing.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A permanent researcher at a French university, research organisation or recognised foundation who can coordinate a 24-48 month precision-psychiatry consortium and produce a 15-page English scientific document.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your coordinating institution falls into one of the three published beneficiary categories before anything else.
Fix the axis first, because it sets both your duration window and your aid band.
Line up a second, different French research structure identified by an RNSR number if you are on the clinical or mixed axis.
Identify and document every cohort, database or health-data warehouse record you will mobilise, including SNDS or French Minds data, before writing the proposal.
Collect each partner's signed commitment letter and the administrative/financial signature early - the scan is part of the complete file.
Open the ANR submission account well before 10 November and read the FAQ published after the 26 August 2026 webinar.
common_rejection_risks: A project that reads as mainly addiction research - only secondary or comorbid addiction questions inside the four target disorders stay in scope.
Requesting aid outside the band for your axis, which makes the file inadmissible.
Clinical or mixed projects assembled around a single French research structure.
A scientific document that overruns 15 pages, is not on the ANR template, or is deposited as a protected PDF.
Leaving the mobilised data sets vague, which makes feasibility inside 24-48 months impossible to verify.
Scientific objectives that duplicate a project already funded by, or currently under evaluation at, the ANR.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The grant covers eligible research expenditure under the PEPR financial regulation only. Anything outside those eligible costs - and every individual's tuition, living costs or personal travel - must be met from other sources.
document_audit: The scientific document template and the publications annex template are two separate Word files; loading the wrong one is a common slip.
The administrative and financial document is an Excel file that must carry partner commitment letters, so signature logistics drive your timeline.
Submission documents and signed documents have distinct upload sections on the submission site; a file placed in the wrong section counts as missing.
A consortium agreement is mandatory only when companies are involved, otherwise within 12 months of signature when required - its absence can stop funding and trigger repayment.
alerts: The published closing date moved from 15 October to 10 November 2026 at 11:00 CET and the original AAP PDF still shows the old date - plan against 10 November.
Teams of the PROPSY 'Projets Cibles' may participate as partners but their coordinators may not coordinate a project in this call.

Beneficiaries must guarantee immediate CC-BY open access, deposit the accepted manuscript in HAL, deliver a data management plan within six months, and mention France 2030 and PEPR PROPSY support in communications.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: The coordinating institution assembles the scientific and administrative/financial files with signed partner letters, uploads them to the ANR submission site, validates the deposit before 10 November 2026 at 11:00 CET, then passes eligibility screening, independent committee evaluation and SGPI and Prime Minister decisions before any aid contract is signed.
